content: We consider the typical zero-shot translation scenario in which a high resource pivot language has parallel data with both source and target languages, while source and target languages has no parallel data between themselves. Our proposed cross-lingual pretraining based transfer approach for source$\rightarrow $target zero-shot translation is mainly divided into two phrases: the pretraining phase and the transfer phase.
